case: Case A: Response Model Simulator — independent aggregate SIM2

implementation.evaluator: Explicit aggregate synthetic expected-attendance rule; no individual synthetic consumers and no real-data fitting.
implementation.search: Deterministic Iterated Local Search (ILS); not Bayesian Optimization.
implementation.closingTest: Final film runtime must finish by 24:40; cleaning after the final film is not included.
implementation.baseline: Capacity-based rotations presolved for 2,600 moves with uniform site taste, then evaluated with the same site-specific response rule as displayed candidates.
implementation.experiment: Exchange film assignments of two actual screening slots from the original reference, with an optional added gap before the first slot. Global film counts are preserved; repacking captures runtime and later-screening changes. Full-plan feasibility and response use the preserved SIM2 engine.
implementation.preview: inspectSwap returns a copied candidate plus score/delta and per-show factors. Preview does not load the plan or count toward displayed search evaluations.
implementation.apply: loadSwap applies only a feasible draft and restarts loaded-plan ILS at seed 20260829. Changing a draft pauses search and disables search until the matching valid draft is applied.
implementation.comparison: Separate original/applied/best records, full-plan/site totals and per-show factor records; selected-site applied/best timetables.
implementation.auxiliaryExperiment: Collapsed whole-screen closing-time shift test, from the original reference; default target Site D / Screen 1. Applying it replaces the search start.
implementation.feasibilityIndicator: Dynamic PASS/FAIL from feasible(bestShows.shows), not a hardcoded zero or cumulative rejected-candidate count.
implementation.proposal: Original-design 44-slide Response proposal retained; broader concepts and prepared illustrations are distinct from this standalone execution.
implementation.export: Snapshot, comparison.original/applied/best full showing records and factors, appliedEdit, current preview, fixture/source settings and bestFeasibleShowings.
implementation.startingModes: Every draft starts from the original reference. Reset constructs that reference through uniform-response presolve and does not apply the selected draft. Applying a swap or auxiliary plan restarts ILS at seed 20260829 directly.
